tellings.quote: Stories about sightings were all over the missile complexes, even reports of cattle mutilations; I once saw two of the dead cows myself while traveling to Kilo-1.

plain: In 1977, around the Ellsworth nuclear missile field, cattle were said to be turning up dead and mutilated, which, if tied to the UFO reports there, would mean the same activity reached the ranches. A former nuclear missile guard named Mario Woods says on the show that there were 'cattle mutilations going on' in the area, crediting the reporter Linda Moulton Howe. Michels, retelling what a man named Michael Johnson told him and Woods, says cattle had been turning up dead around the missile field in the weeks before the November night when the men say their own encounter happened, and adds that a camera was confiscated. A former missile security policeman, quoted in a 2017 article by the researcher Robert Hastings, says stories of sightings and 'even reports of cattle mutilations' were all over the missile complexes, and that 'I once saw two of the dead cows myself.'
